mapper.select: SELECT id,biz_type,project_id,file_name,template_type,total_rows,success_rows,error_rows,status,operator_id,operator_name,created_at FROM req_import_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq_no),0) FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_legacy_requirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND requirement_no=#{requirementNo} AND deleted=0
